style: stylised 3D cartoon render, vibrant saturated colours, soft plastic textures, dry satire
motion_rule: camera orbits the wolf nonstop, drums and sheets tear past every frame; one clear action per beat; wolf head over a third of frame, new shot size each beat; motion across frame, never up-down
character: grey wolf, lean, creased white shirt with rolled sleeves, tie knocked sideways, fills two thirds of frame height in every beat, stands in place, same look throughout
second_characters: ONE sheep laundress in an apron, acts at 4.15-4.95; ONE badger cashier at the counter, acts at 5.70-6.50; in other beats they are merely present
props: ONE white paper envelope, a white band across it reads ОКЛАД in black capitals, no quotes; ONE wet white sheet; A SWARM of wooden clothespins
prop_continuity: one envelope only: swung in from off frame, ripped open and shaken out empty, pressed to the wet sheet, pinned on the line, torn off, hurled into the lens; it comes out of the wash thinner and see-through
environment: narrow laundry aisle, washers both sides, sheets overhead, day window
light_events: wide window at the aisle end blazes daylight into frame; a wet sheet swings off the line at 6.50 and rakes a bright band of it across the wolf

audio.delivery: male voice, weary and venomous, bites off every word, 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: zar-PLA-ta, BE-la-ya, nas-TOL-ko, shto, pros-VE-chi-va-yet; latin hints are never spoken
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.40, 1.40-2.75 and 2.75-4.15 each on one breath; after 4.15 no words, sfx continue

timeline.a: wolf swings the envelope in from off frame left on a straight paw, jaw working
wolf turns his torso after the envelope, holding it into the window light, jaw working
wolf spreads both paws wide, stretching the envelope across frame, jaw working
wolf rips the envelope open and shakes it upside down across frame, nothing falls out, jaw working
wolf flings the envelope out sideways on a straight paw, jaw working
wolf sweeps the envelope overhead across frame, light blasting through the paper, jaw working
the sheep carries the wet sheet across frame past the lens, cloth whipping by
wolf presses the envelope to the sheet and rips it down in a wide sideways swing
the badger hurls a fistful of clothespins across frame straight into the lens
wolf catches a clothespin and pins the envelope onto the line in a sideways swing
wolf hauls the line paw over paw, the envelope and the laundry riding across frame past him
wolf tears the envelope off the line in one pull across frame
wolf hurls the envelope across frame into the lens with a shoulder swing, his face showing through the wet paper
wolf drives sideways past the lens shoulder first, the empty envelope trailing from his paw across frame

must_appear: the ОКЛАД band envelope in every beat; at 2.05-2.75 it is ripped open and nothing falls out; light blasts through it at 3.10-4.15; every line spoken, last word by 4.15; after 8.30 the wolf throws it and drives past the lens himself
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, digits, a price card, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters, slow motion, drawn-out delivery, foreign accent, two actions at once, a closed jaw while speaking, a full envelope, an empty corridor, text overlay, English speech, floating objects, extra limbs, multiple wolves
